column2: Wide landscape 3:2 composition, about 1536x1024. Ground level view of a small garden dirt path running straight across the lower quarter of the picture, seen from the side, with big soft grass blades and a few giant mushrooms behind it, under a heavy overcast grey blue sky with dark rain clouds. Low snail eye view. Calm empty space in the middle.

Wide landscape 3:2 composition, about 1536x1024. Ground level side view of the same kind of garden dirt path running straight across the lower quarter of the picture, now soaking wet and shiny with long puddles reflecting a brightening sky, big grass blades and giant mushrooms behind, grey clouds starting to break with soft light. Low snail eye view. No rain streaks.
